limitations: saved fatness needs a supported personality tail unless explicitly overridden
young breed previews require a valid [Little one] or explicit young_name

repeatability.scope: rendered pixels and resolved appearance; audit IDs and timings may vary
repeatability.saved_seed: saved seed; missing-cache fallback requires nonzero
repeatability.local_files: file changes change the input; paths alone do not identify content

data_handling.processing: request contents and images are held in memory for processing and response
data_handling.audit_logs: when configured, record IDs, hashes, versions, timings and error codes; no contents
data_handling.external_retention: MCP clients and hosting providers may retain their own logs or responses
data_handling.outbound_network_calls_by_tools: only user-supplied public HTTPS file URLs in hosted/advanced mode
data_handling.download_urls: fetched anew; URLs are not included in renderer audit logs; destination sees download requests
